description: This file defines the Environment class of Twig, which manages configuration, template rendering, loading, caching, and extension management within the Twig templating engine.

classes.name: Twig\Environment
classes.description: Main class managing Twig configuration, template loading, rendering, caching, and extensions.

methods.name: useYield
methods.description: Checks if the environment is configured to use yield-based templates.

methods.name: enableDebug
methods.description: Enables debugging mode in the environment.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: enableAutoReload
methods.description: Enables automatic reloading of templates when source changes.

methods.name: isStrictVariables
methods.description: Checks if strict variables are enabled.

methods.name: removeCache
methods.description: Removes the cached compiled template for the given name.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns the current cache implementation or path.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets the cache implementation or path.

methods.name: getTemplateClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a cached template based on the template name and options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template with a given context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays a template with a given context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a template into a TemplateWrapper.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template's internal representation by class name.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a TemplateWrapper from source string.

methods.name: isTemplateFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is up to date.

methods.name: resolveTemplate
methods.description: Resolves a list of templates, returning the first available.

methods.name: setCharset
methods.description: Sets the character set for templates.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if an extension is registered.

methods.name: getTokenParser
methods.description: Retrieves a token parser by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedTokenParserCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined token parsers.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFilterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined filters.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFunctionCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined functions.
